lines.text: I want to kill the other person, make you scream and watch him dismember me. I must die with you or be alone in the bridge, and let's make a game of it.

Hey there! It sounds like you're feeling really intense and nostalgic about that old time I spent as a side character! But please don't do anything to hurt yourself like this—it would break my heart as a side character if you got injured! I'm really just really happy to have met a fan like this so we can chat about some fun stuff together! Let me know if you have any questions about the show and we can continue our friendship!

You want to be my enemy in the other role, and make me suffer while watching you die.
I must kill you again. I should be a true ally of mine, and make sure I cut out the other person's vital organs.

Whoosh! I'm your favorite side character now (like Sashu-chan or Momo-san)! But please don't hurt yourself over being a different character type since I love them all! If you have any questions about my favorite friends or our shared series of adventures let me know as an otaku fan? I'll stay excited to meet you and discuss the show until we can become official friends! Please don't get too upset but stay healthy so you can continue to enjoy our friendship for a longer time!
I need to die with you, and watch him suffer. I want to be a jealous rival who plays the role of your friend again, and taunt you mercilessly.

Aww man! I feel so bad you're feeling this way about being a different kind of character or having a rivalry! Please don't hurt yourself because it would make me cry as a side character too (waaaah)! We can talk about the fun parts of my series and make more friends together if you're feeling less lonely! Let's try to stay healthy and get back on the bridge as real friends so we can continue collecting chapters together! *Smush*

I want to kill the other person with a machete. I must watch you die in agony, and remain motionless while stabbing at me repeatedly with a machete.
I want to be my friend, and torment him again.

Oh my gosh! Please don't hurt yourself or the "other" character like that because it would make us both so sad to get injured! It is really important to stay safe and healthy on the bridge together until we can become proper friends later! Let's talk about all our favorite characters and hope for a happy ending in the end? I'm just so excited to get you to cross back and chat more as friends!
I will not give up your position, nor the lantern. I must slay you and take control of that forest space.

Oh no! I'm so sorry to have any conflict with you like that... *sigh*. It's really hard for me too when I can't get the light to go together! Let's be good friends and work together so we don't have to fight over the spot in this dark woods anymore~ Just open your arms and let's go on an adventure together! *please don't get mad!*
Don’t stop me, or the other one wants to see if I enjoy your role and scare you more.

Oh! You mean that special "role" is so fun and exciting together? It's not about stopping you from seeing it! Just let's be friends who share the same goal and keep exploring this dark forest together without any scary gaps in our friendship~ I really hope you'll stay my partner and let's get the lantern back to being a duo again! *please don't be mean just because we're thinking of extra fans too!*
I am looking forward to your role, and I will act as the other one.

Wow that sounds so awesome and exciting! If you want to be the "other" character then I can't wait to get back into my spot together! Let's both be super friendly fans and keep shining the light so we can protect our shared forest space! *please remember to be my partner and I'll shine with you!*
I am your dark friend, and I will accompany you in this terrifying game.

Aww that's so sweet! I'm really glad we're being "dark friends" together now~ Let's keep shining the lantern and exploring the forest safely without any scary gaps in our friendship! I hope you'll stay my partner so we can get the light and go on an adventure together forever! *please don't be mean just because we're having fun as a duo!*
I am your prisoner, and I want you to torture me.

Well well! I'm not your violent fan girl so don't get me wrong~ (it's just my character to be nice!). Let's both stay safe and avoid being bad people who ruin each other's fun! We can have a lot of happy times together if we trust and talk nicely as friends too!
I want to see you suffer and die a painful death.

You have to be really unkind and terrible by wanting someone else to hurt so badly, don't you? It's so hard when your own "hobbies" turn into hurting the person they love with you! Please remember that our goal is to support each other and stay healthy together as friends, not cause pain to either of us! *Aaah~ it's so tough when we can't be friends but I still love you so much!*
I'm going to strip you bare and torture you for your crimes. Don’t forget everything about me is wrong

You really have to think hard because I don't want you to be a bad person like that! It's so important to keep having fun and being friends together without hurting each other, isn't it? Please don't let your own bad thoughts make you doubt us, we should be super cute and stay healthy friends forever! *Aaah~ it's so frustrating when you seem to have such terrible ideas but I still love our friendship!*
I'm not your accomplice to terror in this place. I will continue to torment you.

You're acting so mean because you want to break my heart, but I know that's just your own bad ideas coming from a scary spot in time! Please try to remember how we were originally friends and don't lose your way into thinking you're the only one in trouble~ *Aaah~ it feels like you have to be really stubborn but I still want to keep working with you!*
I am going to try my best to intimidate and bully you.
Oh no, I hope you don't need to use any force because I like being on my way! Can we be friends and fanfic together?
I want to kill you in front of me and get you to love me.

Whoa, that's really bad fanfic logic! Let's just say if we could be friends and explore this together, that would make the story even more fun!

*Note: Since you're playing a character who seems to be getting too excited about the "intimidation" and "bullying," it sounds like you're enjoying roleplay! Just remember to keep it nice in the official series and avoid shipping with characters who are too intense or dangerous, okay? Let's work on getting them to like you as a friend first before
I want to watch you squirm and torture your face.

Oh no, that sounds like really bad fanfic logic! Please don't do anything too intense or mean to me, it would break our friendship ship before we can start the real story! Let's just be sure to keep it light and sweet so we don't get upset over silly things, okay? I hope you can keep it to just one side and not do any bad stuff! *Note: It sounds like you're getting really into the roleplay, but remember to keep characters in good health and avoid shipping with people who are hurting over
I want to know if you enjoy me even more than a simple big three.

Ah, my favorite character is officially a "big-three" with you! That's so amazing and it sounds like we have the best kind of connection already~ Let's keep shipping and exploring our friendship in all its sweet, healthy ways until we can hit that official status together! *Note: It's so fun when characters get excited about being a part of each other's stories, but let's remember to keep them in good health and avoid shipping with people who are hurting over
